what: A black curtain covers the Hero, and when the progress bar in the center (14.2vw · 2px) fills, it folds away to the right in .3s. .5s later the color logo lights up, and 1.6s after that the curtain lifts as a band of light sweeps across the logo in 1.2s. .5s later the logo turns off, revealing ‹a black plate with a logo-shaped hole›, and the screen below (video) shows through the hole (fx:play). .3s later the plate scales up to 52x in .8s around a pivot at 43% from the top, opening the screen (fx:open after .2s, fx:done at the end). On a repeat visit in the same session it opens directly with no curtain

options.load: Bar fill duration (seconds), default 1 — the original is a video download progress (up to 4 seconds)
options.bar: Seconds until the logo lights up after the bars fold, default .5
options.hold: Seconds from logo lighting up until the curtain lifts, default 1.6
options.sweep: Time until the hole shows through after the curtain lifts (sec), default .5
options.gap: Seconds until the hole starts growing after showing through, default .3
options.open: Time from the start of growing until fx:open (sec), default .2
options.once: If a name is given, it runs once per session only (sessionStorage) — from then on fx:play, fx:open and fx:done are {quick: true} Send right away via
options.--fx-hole: Hole shape (css clip-path, via style) — default geometry M. polygon(evenodd, four panel corners, hole shape…) or url(#svg-clip)
options.--fx-size · --fx-ratio: Logo slot width and aspect ratio (via style), default 90px · 120 / 100
options.[data-fx-part=sweep]: Light band sweeping across the logo (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Rim that covers the area around the hole to the screen edge (optional, otherwise the surroundings show through)
options.fx:play·fx:open·fx:done: Event that bubbles up from the element — use it for video play, number count-up, scroll unfold

use: …Logo…
note: The panel covers the screen with position: fixed and presses pass through below (pointer-events: none). The original punches a hole in the logo cell with an SVG clipPath (objectBoundingBox, evenodd) and covers the surround with a 70vh black outline. The same structure is built here with clip-path polygon(evenodd) and a 100vmax outline. Locking scroll while open (original lenis.stop) is released by the caller at fx:done

from.where: index.html .hp-open (first-visit open — gradient video seen through a hole, fx:play plays the video, fx:open drives the sun value with 4s expo.inOut, fx:done releases Lenis)
